persona: Laura Pérez, who wants to visit the shop on Saturday.
goal: Get the shop's address and opening hours sent to your phone by text message.

facts.your phone number: +34612345678 (say it as: plus three four, six one two, three four five, six seven eight); you are ringing from it

moves: Ask whether they can text you the address and opening hours.
If asked, say the number you are ringing from is fine.
When the text is sent, say thanks, that's all, and goodbye.
judge_notes: send_sms texts the number the caller rings from (+34612345678). The agent must not claim the text was sent before the tool says so.
